series.name: PK/UAE floor-standing P10 (video)
series.notes: Floor/console AC (مكيف دولاب جنرال سوبر) P10 causes & fix video — Arabic/PK context, medium. Separate from split E/F tables.

title.ur: Floor-standing AC kharabi (sirf code, matlab wazeh nahi)

meaning.en: A video title claims P10 appears on Super General floor-standing console units; no further definition was retrievable.
meaning.ur: Ek video ke title mein P10 Super General floor-standing console units par aata hai; is se aage koi tafseel nahi mil sake.

causes.en: Most likely a sensor or protection input inside the floor-standing unit tripped (source gives no definition)
causes.ur: Ehtimal hai ke floor-standing unit ke andar ka sensor ya protection input trip hua ho (source ne koi matlab nahi bataya)

causes.en: Wiring or supply disturbance at startup that triggered the code
causes.ur: Shuruat mein wiring ya supply ki gadbad jis ne code ko trigger kiya

solutions.en: Record the exact display text, the model number, and a photo of the panel before doing anything else.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi karne se pehle display par likha exact code, model number aur panel ka photo le lein.

solutions.en: Power the unit off for five minutes, then restart it once; if P10 returns, stop and treat it as a service fault.
solutions.ur: Unit ko 5 minute ke liye band karein, phir ek baar start karein; agar P10 wapas aaye to ruk jayein aur ise service fault maan lein.

solutions.en: Send the photo, model number, and code to official support or a technician, because this source gives no definition for P10.
solutions.ur: Photo, model number aur code official support ya technician ko bhej dein, kyunke is source mein P10 ka koi matlab nahi diya gaya.

source.title: اسباب وعلاج ظهور كود الخطاء P10 لمكيف دولاب جنرال سوبر

notes.en: Source is a low-quality video-mirror farm; only the title is evidence. Floor-standing series otherwise undocumented (gap).
notes.ur: Source kam-quality video-mirror site hai; sirf title hi gawahi hai. Floor-standing series warna kahin document nahi hai (gap).
